notes: The account name geohazard-foundry-mcap is historical -- it hosts several unrelated demo projects. Only the PROJECT name matters for scoping.

referral-project was created for this demo rather than reusing genomics-project, whose name describes the superseded variant-interpretation build and would restart exactly the confusion this repository exists to correct.
Foundry User (53ca6127-db72-4b80-b1b0-d745d6d5456d) is assigned at PROJECT scope. Account scope returns 401 indefinitely and reads like propagation delay -- it is not.
az role assignment create cannot target a project sub-resource: it returns MissingSubscription regardless of --subscription. Use the Authorization REST API directly.
az resource create rejects the projects type as InvalidResourceTypeNameFormat. Use az rest PUT against management.azure.com at api-version 2025-06-01.

A newly created project stays eventually-consistent on the data plane: ARM reports Succeeded while creates intermittently 404, and the services.ai / cognitiveservices host names propagate independently. create_referral_agent.py probes with a real write and picks the host that answers.
